steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Respiration: An exothermic reaction in which glucose is broken down to release energy for living processes. Respiration happens in every living cell, all the time.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Write the word and symbol equations for aerobic respiration. | Write the word equations for anaerobic respiration in: (a) animal cells, (b) yeast cells. | Explain why aerobic respiration releases more energy per glucose molecule than anaerobic respiration.
